meta.title: Chat Image Lightbox
meta.description: Click a chat image for a full-screen lightbox with zoom, drag-pan, save-as download and prev/next paging; collapse the whole conversation into a thumbnail grid with adjustable columns or hide all images. TIFF/HEIC is transcoded losslessly, hotlink-protected images are cached locally, and images are forced into the reply body instead of a collapsed tool row.
